column1: BOSS\tRoland\tOWNER_PARENT\tVERIFIED\tHIGH\tBOSS is Roland's effects brand; keep retail brand and corporate owner distinct in archive identity graph.\thttps://cdn.roland.com/assets/media/pdf/boss_catalog_2012.pdf

BOSS\tOD-1\tFIRST_COMPACT_DIRT_ANCHOR\tVERIFIED\tHIGH\tOfficial BOSS history dates first compact effects launch to 1977 and identifies OD-1 as the first compact unit.\thttps://cdn.roland.com/assets/media/pdf/boss_catalog_2012.pdf ; https://www.roland.com/us/company/press_releases/2017/BOSS-CELEBRATES-40th-ANNIVERSARY-WITH-LIMITED-EDIT/

BOSS\tDS-1\tDIRT_LINEAGE\tVERIFIED\tHIGH\tOfficial BOSS history places DS-1 in the early compact-era lineage; 2017 anniversary release confirms its long-running status.\thttps://www.roland.com/us/company/press_releases/2017/BOSS-CELEBRATES-40th-ANNIVERSARY-WITH-LIMITED-EDIT/

BOSS\tFZ-2 / FZ-3 / FZ-5\tFUZZ_LINEAGE\tVERIFIED_SECONDARY\tHIGH\tTreat as separate models, not one generational object. BOSS catalog material lists distinct compact fuzz products; later FZ-5 is a separate modern model.\thttps://cdn.roland.com/assets/media/pdf/boss_catalog_2008.pdf
DOD\tDigiTech\tBRAND_SUCCESSOR\tVERIFIED\tHIGH\tDOD and DigiTech belong in the same corporate/brand lineage graph but are not interchangeable maker labels.\thttps://digitech.com/history/

DOD\tFX-series\tMODEL_NUMBER_FAMILY\tVERIFIED\tHIGH\tFX numbering is a catalog family and must not be treated as chronology by number alone; period catalogs and manuals establish different production corridors.\thttps://digitech.com/product-manuals/

DOD\tFX50B / FX52 / FX53 / FX55B / FX56 / FX57 / FX58 / FX59\tPERIOD_CATALOG_CORRIDOR\tVERIFIED_SECONDARY\tHIGH\t1992 Electronic Musician guide independently confirms this group as a contemporaneous FX-series corridor.\thttps://www.worldradiohistory.com/Archive-All-Music/Electronic-Musician/1992/Electronic-Musician-1992-04.pdf

Ibanez\tMaxon / Nisshin Onpa\tOEM_MANUFACTURER_LINEAGE\tVERIFIED\tHIGH\tMaxon/Nisshin Onpa is the manufacturing lineage behind major Ibanez effects families; retail Ibanez and physical manufacturer remain distinct entities.\thttps://maxonfx.com/pages/about-maxon-guitar-effects-pedals-maxonfx-com

Ibanez\tOD-808 / TS808\tOEM_RETAIL_RELATIONSHIP\tVERIFIED\tHIGH\tPreserve OD-808 and TS808 as separate retail/product names linked through the Maxon/Nisshin manufacturing/design lineage.\thttps://maxonfx.com/pages/about-maxon-guitar-effects-pedals-maxonfx-com

Ibanez\tSoundtank\tMANUFACTURER_EXCEPTION\tEVIDENCE_REVIEW\tMEDIUM\tDo not automatically inherit the Maxon relationship from early Ibanez dirt products. Soundtank remains model/period-specific until factory evidence is established.\thttps://www.ibanez.com/usa/support/catalogs/

Sola Sound / Colorsound\tColorsound\tMARKETING_LINEAGE\tVERIFIED\tHIGH\tColorsound is the later Sola Sound branded line; preserve the manufacturing entity and marketing label separately.\thttps://www.kitrae.net/music/Music_mp3_Colorsound_Sound.html ; https://www.premierguitar.com/gear/stompbox-classics-tone-bender-part-2

Sola Sound / Colorsound\tPower Boost / Overdriver\tRENAMING_TRANSITION\tVERIFIED_SECONDARY\tHIGH\tEvidence supports an early Power Boost corridor followed by Overdriver naming; preserve both model states rather than collapsing names.\thttps://www.kitrae.net/music/Music_mp3_Colorsound_Sound.html ; https://www.analogman.com/colorsnd.htm

Sola Sound / Colorsound\tTone Bender Fuzz\tMODEL_STATE\tVERIFIED_SECONDARY\tHIGH\tEarly-1970s Tone Bender Fuzz is distinct from earlier three-transistor Tone Bender identities and later Supa/Jumbo states.\thttps://www.premierguitar.com/gear/stompbox-classics-tone-bender-part-2 ; https://www.guitarcenter.com/riffs/gear-tips/amplifiers--effects/history-tone-bender

Sola Sound / Colorsound\tSupa Tone Bender / Jumbo Tone Bender\tFAMILY_RENAME\tVERIFIED_SECONDARY\tHIGH\tKeep Supa Tone Bender and Jumbo Tone Bender as distinct searchable names while recording the documented rename/continuity relationship.\thttps://www.guitarcenter.com/riffs/gear-tips/amplifiers--effects/history-tone-bender

Sola Sound / Colorsound\tVox Power Boost\tOEM_MARKETED_VARIANT\tEVIDENCE_REVIEW\tMEDIUM\tA separate Vox-marketed Power Boost state is documented around the early-1970s transition; do not merge it with standard Colorsound retail states.\thttps://www.kitrae.net/music/Music_mp3_Colorsound_Sound.html
